customDomains.title: Your own domain
customDomains.description: Your page and pieces live at your Twyne address. Pages on a domain you own, like example.com or pages.example.com, are coming. There's no extra charge for them.
customDomains.addressPieces: Each piece gets its own address under it, like {example}.
customDomains.waitlistBody: We're opening custom domains a few writers at a time. Join the waitlist and we'll set yours up with you when there's room. You don't need a domain yet.
customDomains.waitlistJoinedFor: We'll set up {hostname} with you when there's room. Your Twyne address keeps working in the meantime.
customDomains.waitlistJoinedNoDomain: We'll get in touch when there's room. Add the domain you'd use whenever you have one.
customDomains.needsHandle: Claim your Twyne address above first. Your domain will show the page at that address.
customDomains.limitReached: You've connected {limit} domains. Remove one to add another.
customDomains.recordsIntro: Create these records at your DNS host. Changes can take a few minutes to show up, sometimes longer.
customDomains.apexNote: A bare domain needs an ALIAS, ANAME or flattened CNAME record. Porkbun, Cloudflare and many other DNS hosts support one. If yours doesn't, add www.{hostname} here instead, and have your DNS host redirect {hostname} to it.
customDomains.txtNote: The TXT record shows the domain is yours. Leave it in place.
customDomains.removeConfirm: Remove {hostname}? Your page will stop showing there.

errors.HOSTNAME_EMPTY: Enter a domain, like example.com or pages.example.com.
errors.HOSTNAME_INVALID: That isn't a domain name. Use something like example.com or pages.example.com.
errors.HOSTNAME_TOO_LONG: That domain name is too long.
errors.HOSTNAME_IP: Use a domain name, not an IP address.
errors.HOSTNAME_TWYNE: Twyne addresses come with your account. Add a domain you own instead.
errors.HOSTNAME_PROVIDER: That name belongs to a hosting provider. Add a domain you own instead.
errors.HOSTNAME_WILDCARD: Add one domain at a time. Wildcards aren't supported.
errors.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_TAKEN: Another Twyne writer has added that domain. If it's yours, contact support.
errors.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_LIMIT: You can connect up to {limit} domains. Remove one to add another.
errors.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NEEDS_HANDLE: Claim your Twyne address first. A custom domain shows the page at that address.
errors.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_REMOVING: That domain is still being removed. Try again in a minute.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes at once. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.CUSTOM_DOMAIN_WAITLIST: Custom domains aren't open yet. Join the waitlist and we'll set yours up when there's room.
